contract: Public /leaderboard: retain the real top-50 Elo ordering, live query, retry and ranked entry. Make six existing tiers recognizable as metallic shield emblems, reused in dashboard/history; emphasize the leading players with a podium. Reuse the warm shell with a restrained slate/gold arena, shared buttons, schema ratingTier and Korean/English dictionaries. No rank rules, data writes, new dependencies or invented live standings. Priorities: ranked entry, tier progression, top three, full player standings. Loading/empty/error keep useful feedback and recovery. Target desktop, tablet and phone with full accessible tier labels and long nicknames contained.

accessibility.evidence: Browser assertions: decorative SVGs accompany visible tier names, table has caption/column and row headers and a named focusable region. Ranked CTA is at least 44px high. Keyboard focus revealed a shared outline-style issue, repaired with focus-visible:outline-solid; the dark arena uses a contrasting pale-gold 2px outline (keyboard-focus.png). Reduced-motion emulation disables the icon transition. Player markup renders as text. Text uses dark tier colors on pale backgrounds. No full WCAG certification or screen-reader session.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and visually reviewed all three targets. Document widths equal 1440, 768 and 375; table widths are 1054, 718 and 341. Long names truncate while retaining full DOM text/title. Mobile places tier below player name and retains wins/played below win rate. English phone and tablet labels fit; one- and two-player podiums contain only available players.

loading.evidence: Delayed intercepted read after retry displays Loading leaderboard… with status semantics; loading.png.

empty.evidence: Empty intercepted ranking response shows the bronze shield, first-match explanation and ranked link; no podium; empty.png.

error.evidence: HTTP 500 fixture shows an alert and Try again. Clicking retry transitions through loading and restores all six ranking rows; error.png.

partial.evidence: One- and two-player responses show exactly one/two podium places and rows, without fabricated empty ranks; live-desktop.png also captures two actual available records.

success.evidence: Six fixture ranks cover every badge and display correct first-place player, Elo and win counts. Both locales render correctly. Updated metallic revision passes the browser suite without page errors. Historical live-* images document a prior unmocked public read, not a new authenticated verification.

permission.evidence: Guest can view rankings. Following the ranked CTA reaches the existing Sign in for ranked gate, without creating an account or starting a match.

renderedEvidence.observation: Six browser-only fixtures, three-place podium, all table columns and six distinct badge silhouettes.
Tablet shows the six-tier trail and readable podium/table; secondary numeric columns collapse into the record label.
Phone uses a 3-by-2 tier guide, three-place podium and compact standings with no horizontal document or table overflow.
